subject: general
question: The Tadoba National Park is located in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra** is a state in the** western region** of India, known for its** diverse culture, history, and natural beauty.**
 
• **Tadoba National Park** is one of the largest and oldest national parks in Maharashtra, covering an area of around **625 square kilometers.**
 
• The park is home to a variety of flora and fauna, including** tigers, leopards, sloth bears, sambar deer, and Indian bison.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is a state in** northern** India, known for its historical monuments, temples, and rich cultural heritage.

 
 
• It is home to **Dudhwa National Park, Kishanpur Wildlife Sanctuary, Ranipur Wildlife Sanctuary **etc.
 
 
 
• **Bihar** is a state in** eastern **India, known for its archaeological sites, temples, and festivals.
 
 
• It is home to **Bhimbandh Sanctuary, Gautam Budha Wildlife Sanctuary, Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuar**y etc. 
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan** is a state in **northwestern** India, known for its forts, palaces, and desert landscapes.
 
 
• It is home to **Keoladeo National Park, Ranthambore National Park,** etc.
